load_and_transform_audio_data: load audio files or tensors and transform them into normalized mel-spectrogram clips for ImageBind
create_VideoTransform: create a VideoTransform instance that scales, normalizes, and crops video frames into clips for ImageBind
transform_video_VideoTransform: transform a batch of video tensors with durations into normalized spatially cropped clips on a device
load_video_fast_VideoTransform: load video tensors efficiently by computing frame indices and sub-sampling only the needed frames
forward_ImageBindRanker: run the ImageBindRanker forward pass to compute audio-video similarity scores from extracted audio and video tensors
